scope: Face-signature lookup only; no claim about full mesher memory or runtime
algorithm: Stable sort of compact four-int64 keys plus chunked search; O(N log N) preprocessing and O(M log N) matching, with 16384 query records per chunk
behavior: Exact existing face ID/order, final face wins on duplicate signatures, absent signatures rejected

tests.result: 13 passed; exact IDs tested across int32/int64 and contiguous/Fortran/strided inputs

benchmark.input: 100000 distinct four-int32 face signatures in reverse query order; isolated subprocess for each algorithm
benchmark.result: Both exact face ID sequences valid; lookup-only peak RSS increment fell from 29588 to 10372 KiB in this run
